outputs.explanation: Panel A shows selected frames from a photoactivation time-lapse of a single representative cell for each construct (H1.1, RCC1, H1t). The caption gives no indication of how many cells or independent experiments were imaged/repeated to obtain this representative example, so neither the number nor the type of replicate is reported.

replicate_statements: Graphs representing normalized intensities measured during relaxation in the circled regions of the experiment displayed in (A)
Insets represent average early time points responses measured in euchromatin and heterochromatin (red and green data sets, respectively) to emphasize on the initial plateau in heterochromatin.
outputs.explanation: The caption explicitly states that inset curves represent 'average' responses, indicating that multiple measurements (replicates) were combined, but it does not state how many replicates (cells, experiments, or ROIs) were averaged nor what kind of replicate they represent, so the replication information required for an averaged/error-bar plot is missing.
